Name: Default Tool Slots
Author: Freaksaus
Description:
A very simple mod. Go to the options, pick a default slot for each of your tools and you're good to go!

Any inventory change will sort your tools so that they're always in the slot you prefer. No more manually having to rearrange your tools after pulling them from your chests, it's all done for you.

Also comes with a hotkey to toggle the mod if you want to turn it off.
